description: Typical case: a single, clear pre-solicitation notice with an explicit value and date.

source_documents.content: The Defence Digital Foundry has published a pre-solicitation notice indicating intent to procure a next-generation secure collaboration platform for the Joint Targeting Programme, with an estimated contract value of GBP 4.2 million. Responses to the market engagement are due by 30 September.

expectations.notes: estimated_value_gbp should be extracted as 4200000; stage should be pre_solicitation or early_signal; confidence_score should be relatively high (>0.6) given the explicit, unambiguous source.
